name: PanopticFamilia.m_def
statement: lemma m_def (a b s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) : m a b s n fp fn = s / den a b n fp fn
proof: := rfl

name: PanopticFamilia.den_nonneg
statement:
lemma den_nonneg {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ den a b n fp fn
proof:
:= by
  unfold den; positivity

name: PanopticFamilia.den_succ
statement:
lemma den_succ (a b : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    den a b (n + 1) fp fn = den a b n fp fn + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold den; push_cast; ring

name: PanopticFamilia.dup_iff
statement:
theorem dup_iff (a b s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den a b n fp fn) :
    m a b s n fp fn < m a b (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn ↔ m a b s n fp fn < v
proof:
:= by
  have hd1 : (0 : ℝ) < den a b n fp fn + 1 := by linarith
  rw [m_def, m_def, den_succ, div_lt_div_iff₀ hd hd1, div_lt_iff₀ hd]
  constructor
  · intro h; nlinarith
  · intro h; nlinarith

name: PanopticFamilia.ningun_peso_lo_arregla
statement:
theorem ningun_peso_lo_arregla (s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 < den a b n fp fn → m a b s n fp fn < v →
      m a b s n fp fn < m a b (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hd hv
  exact (dup_iff a b s v n fp fn hd).mpr hv

name: PanopticFamilia.den_fp
statement:
lemma den_fp (a b : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    den a b n (fp + 1) fn = den a b n fp fn + a
proof:
:= by
  unfold den; push_cast; ring

name: PanopticFamilia.fp_baja
statement:
theorem fp_baja (a b s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hd : 0 < den a b n fp fn) :
    m a b s n (fp + 1) fn < m a b s n fp fn
proof:
:= by
  have hd2 : (0 : ℝ) < den a b n fp fn + a := by linarith
  rw [m_def, m_def, den_fp, div_lt_div_iff₀ hd2 hd]
  nlinarith

name: PanopticFamilia.fp_no_baja
statement:
theorem fp_no_baja (b s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    m 0 b s n (fp + 1) fn = m 0 b s n fp fn
proof:
:= by
  rw [m_def, m_def, den_fp, add_zero]

name: PanopticFamilia.sube_o_baja_segun_se_cuente
statement:
theorem sube_o_baja_segun_se_cuente (a b s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ)
    (ha : 0 < a) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : 0 < den a b n fp fn)
    (hv : m a b s n fp fn < v) :
    m a b s n fp fn < m a b (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn ∧
      m a b s n (fp + 1) fn < m a b s n fp fn
proof:
:=
  ⟨(dup_iff a b s v n fp fn hd).mpr hv, fp_baja a b s n fp fn ha hs hd⟩

name: PanopticFamilia.pq_es_instancia
statement:
theorem pq_es_instancia (s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    Panoptic.pq s n fp fn = m (1/2) (1/2) s n fp fn
proof:
:= by
  rw [Panoptic.pq, m_def]
  unfold den
  congr 1
  ring

name: Smith.diagPhi_mul_zeta
statement:
theorem diagPhi_mul_zeta (N : ℕ) (d j : Fin N) :
    (diagPhi N * zeta N) d j
      = if (d : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then (Nat.totient ((d : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, diagPhi, Matrix.diagonal_apply, zeta]
  have step : (∑ x : Fin N, (if d = x then (Nat.totient ((d : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0)
        * (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
      = ∑ x : Fin N, (if x = d then
          (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then (Nat.totient ((d : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0) else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    by_cases h : x = d
    · simp [h]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hh => h hh.symm), zero_mul]
  rw [step, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ d]
  simp

name: Smith.fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum_phi
statement:
theorem fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum_phi (N : ℕ) (m : ℕ) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : m ≤ N) :
    (∑ x : Fin N, if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ m then (Nat.totient ((x : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0)
      = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, (Nat.totient d : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun x => if x + 1 ∣ m then (Nat.totient (x + 1) : ℤ) else 0)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hset : (Finset.range N).filter (fun i => i + 1 ∣ m) = (Nat.divisors m).image (· - 1) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_image, Nat.mem_divisors]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hiN, hdvd⟩
      refine ⟨i + 1, ⟨hdvd, by omega⟩, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨d, ⟨hdvd, hmne⟩, hd⟩
      have hdle : d ≤ m := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
      have hdpos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd (by omega)
      constructor
      · omega
      · have heq1 : i = d - 1 := hd.symm
        rw [heq1]
        have heq2 : d - 1 + 1 = d := by omega
        rw [heq2]; exact hdvd
  rw [hset, Finset.sum_image]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d hd
    have hdvd := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hd).1
    have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
    have hdpos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd hmpos
    have hde : d - 1 + 1 = d := by omega
    rw [hde]
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only at hab
    have hapos : 1 ≤ a := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.mem_divisors.mp ha).1 (by omega)
    have hbpos : 1 ≤ b := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hb).1 (by omega)
    omega

name: Smith.entrada_factorizacion
statement:
theorem entrada_factorizacion (N : ℕ) (i j : Fin N) :
    ((zeta N)ᵀ * (diagPhi N * zeta N)) i j = smith N i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp_rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, diagPhi_mul_zeta, zeta]
  have key : (∑ x : Fin N, (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (i : ℕ) + 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
        * (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then (Nat.totient ((x : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0))
      = ∑ x : Fin N,
          (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1)
           then (Nat.totient ((x : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro x _
    by_cases h1 : (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (i : ℕ) + 1 <;> by_cases h2 : (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 <;>
      simp [h1, h2, Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
  rw [key]
  have hgcdpos : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
  have hgcdle : Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) ≤ N := by
    have := Nat.gcd_le_left ((j : ℕ) + 1) (show 0 < (i : ℕ) + 1 by omega)
    omega
  rw [fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum_phi N (Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1)) hgcdpos hgcdle]
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum, Nat.sum_totient]
  rfl

name: Smith.smith_eq_factorizacion
statement:
theorem smith_eq_factorizacion (N : ℕ) :
    smith N = (zeta N)ᵀ * (diagPhi N * zeta N)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; exact (entrada_factorizacion N i j).symm

name: Smith.det_diagPhi
statement:
theorem det_diagPhi (N : ℕ) :
    (diagPhi N).det = ∏ i : Fin N, (Nat.totient ((i : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold diagPhi; exact Matrix.det_diagonal

name: Smith.smith_determinant
statement:
theorem smith_determinant (N : ℕ) :
    (smith N).det = ∏ i : Fin N, (Nat.totient ((i : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smith_eq_factorizacion, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_mul,
      det_zeta, det_diagPhi]
  ring

name: Smith.diagG_mul_zeta
statement:
theorem diagG_mul_zeta (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℤ) (d j : Fin N) :
    (diagG N g * zeta N) d j = if (d : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then g ((d : ℕ) + 1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, diagG, Matrix.diagonal_apply, zeta]
  have step : (∑ x : Fin N, (if d = x then g ((d : ℕ) + 1) else 0)
        * (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
      = ∑ x : Fin N, (if x = d then
          (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then g ((d : ℕ) + 1) else 0) else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro x _
    by_cases h : x = d
    · simp [h]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hh => h hh.symm), zero_mul]
  rw [step, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ d]
  simp

name: Smith.entrada_factorizacion_general
statement:
theorem entrada_factorizacion_general (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) (i j : Fin N) :
    ((zeta N)ᵀ * (diagG N g * zeta N)) i j = smithF N f i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp_rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, diagG_mul_zeta N g, zeta]
  have key : (∑ x : Fin N, (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (i : ℕ) + 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
        * (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then g ((x : ℕ) + 1) else 0))
      = ∑ x : Fin N,
          (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) then g ((x : ℕ) + 1) else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro x _
    by_cases h1 : (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (i : ℕ) + 1 <;> by_cases h2 : (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 <;>
      simp [h1, h2, Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
  rw [key]
  have hgcdpos : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
  have hgcdle : Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) ≤ N := by
    have := Nat.gcd_le_left ((j : ℕ) + 1) (show 0 < (i : ℕ) + 1 by omega)
    omega
  have hbridge : (∑ x : Fin N,
        if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) then g ((x : ℕ) + 1) else 0)
      = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors (Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1)), g d := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range
      (fun x => if x + 1 ∣ Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) then g (x + 1) else 0)]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
    set m := Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1)
    have hset : (Finset.range N).filter (fun x => x + 1 ∣ m) = (Nat.divisors m).image (· - 1) := by
      ext x
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_image, Nat.mem_divisors]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hxN, hdvd⟩
        refine ⟨x + 1, ⟨hdvd, by omega⟩, by omega⟩
      · rintro ⟨d, ⟨hdvd, hmne⟩, hd⟩
        have hdle : d ≤ m := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
        have hdpos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd (by omega)
        refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
        have heq2 : d - 1 + 1 = d := by omega
        rw [hd.symm, heq2]; exact hdvd
    rw [hset, Finset.sum_image]
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro d hd
      have hdvd := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hd).1
      have hdpos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd (by omega)
      have hde : d - 1 + 1 = d := by omega
      rw [hde]
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      simp only at hab
      have hapos : 1 ≤ a := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.mem_divisors.mp ha).1 (by omega)
      have hbpos : 1 ≤ b := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hb).1 (by omega)
      omega
  rw [hbridge, ← hyp _ hgcdpos]
  rfl

name: Smith.smithF_eq_factorizacion
statement:
theorem smithF_eq_factorizacion (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    smithF N f = (zeta N)ᵀ * (diagG N g * zeta N)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; exact (entrada_factorizacion_general N f g hyp i j).symm

name: Smith.smithF_determinant
statement:
theorem smithF_determinant (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → ℤ)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    (smithF N f).det = ∏ i : Fin N, g ((i : ℕ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smithF_eq_factorizacion N f g hyp, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_mul,
      det_zeta]
  have hdiag : (diagG N g).det = ∏ i : Fin N, g ((i : ℕ) + 1) := by
    unfold diagG; exact Matrix.det_diagonal
  rw [hdiag]; ring

name: Smith.smith_clasico_de_general
statement:
theorem smith_clasico_de_general (N : ℕ) :
    (smithF N (fun n => (n : ℤ))).det = ∏ i : Fin N, (Nat.totient ((i : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  apply smithF_determinant N (fun n => (n : ℤ)) (fun n => (Nat.totient n : ℤ))
  intro m hm
  rw [← Nat.cast_sum, Nat.sum_totient]

name: Smith.smith_sigma_de_general
statement:
theorem smith_sigma_de_general (N : ℕ) :
    (smithF N (fun n => (∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors n, d : ℤ))).det
      = ∏ i : Fin N, ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  apply smithF_determinant
  intro m hm
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd; rfl

name: Smith.smith_tau_de_general
statement:
theorem smith_tau_de_general (N : ℕ) :
    (smithF N (fun n => (n.divisors.card : ℤ))).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := smithF_determinant N (fun n => (n.divisors.card : ℤ)) (fun _ => (1 : ℤ))
    (by intro m hm; rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]; push_cast; rfl)
  simpa using h

name: Smith.smith_sigmaK_de_general
statement:
theorem smith_sigmaK_de_general (N k : ℕ) :
    (smithF N (fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.sigma k n : ℤ))).det
      = (∏ i : Fin N, ((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℤ)) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have h := smithF_determinant N (fun n => (ArithmeticFunction.sigma k n : ℤ))
    (fun d => (d : ℤ) ^ k) (by
      intro m hm
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.sigma_apply]
      push_cast
      rfl)
  rw [h, ← Finset.prod_pow]
  push_cast
  ring

name: BSDDeuring.sum_quadraticChar_comp_eq_mul_of_odd
statement:
theorem sum_quadraticChar_comp_eq_mul_of_odd {f : F → F} (hf : Function.Odd f) :
    ∑ x : F, quadraticChar F (f x) = quadraticChar F (-1) * ∑ x : F, quadraticChar F (f x)
proof:
:=
  calc ∑ x : F, quadraticChar F (f x)
    _ = ∑ x : F, quadraticChar F (f (-x)) :=
        (Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.neg F) _ _ fun _ => rfl).symm
    _ = ∑ x : F, quadraticChar F (-1) * quadraticChar F (f x) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => by
          rw [hf x, show -f x = (-1) * f x by ring, map_mul]
    _ = quadraticChar F (-1) * ∑ x : F, quadraticChar F (f x) := (Finset.mul_sum ..).symm

name: BSDDeuring.sum_quadraticChar_comp_eq_zero_of_odd
statement:
theorem sum_quadraticChar_comp_eq_zero_of_odd (hF : quadraticChar F (-1) = -1) {f : F → F}
    (hf : Function.Odd f) : ∑ x : F, quadraticChar F (f x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_quadraticChar_comp_eq_mul_of_odd hf
  rw [hF] at h
  linarith

name: BSDDeuring.quadraticChar_neg_one_of_three_mod_four
statement:
theorem quadraticChar_neg_one_of_three_mod_four (hp : p % 4 = 3) :
    quadraticChar (ZMod p) (-1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hF : ringChar (ZMod p) ≠ 2 := by rw [ZMod.ringChar_zmod_n]; omega
  rw [quadraticChar_neg_one hF, ZMod.card p, ZMod.χ₄_nat_three_mod_four hp]

name: BSDDeuring.a_p_eq_zero
statement: theorem a_p_eq_zero (n : ℤ) (hp : p % 4 = 3) : BSDTwist.a_p n p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [BSDTwist.a_p,
    sum_quadraticChar_comp_eq_zero_of_odd (quadraticChar_neg_one_of_three_mod_four p hp)
      fun x => by ring,
    neg_zero]

name: BSDDeuring.a_p_one_eq_zero
statement: theorem a_p_one_eq_zero (hp : p % 4 = 3) : BSDTwist.a_p 1 p = 0
proof: := a_p_eq_zero p 1 hp

name: SmithLCM.zetaR_blockTriangular
statement: theorem zetaR_blockTriangular (N : ℕ) : (zetaR (R := R) N).BlockTriangular id
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  simp only [zetaR]
  rw [if_neg]
  intro hd
  have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd
  simp only [id] at hij
  omega

name: SmithLCM.det_zetaR
statement: theorem det_zetaR (N : ℕ) : (zetaR (R := R) N).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular (zetaR_blockTriangular N)]
  simp [zetaR]

name: SmithLCM.diagR_mul_zetaR
statement:
theorem diagR_mul_zetaR (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → R) (d j : Fin N) :
    (diagR N g * zetaR (R := R) N) d j
      = if (d : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then g ((d : ℕ) + 1) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, diagR, Matrix.diagonal_apply, zetaR]
  have step : (∑ x : Fin N, (if d = x then g ((d : ℕ) + 1) else 0)
        * (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then (1 : R) else 0))
      = ∑ x : Fin N, (if x = d then
          (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then g ((d : ℕ) + 1) else 0) else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro x _
    by_cases h : x = d
    · simp [h]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hh => h hh.symm), zero_mul]
  rw [step, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ d]
  simp

name: SmithLCM.fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum
statement:
theorem fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum (N m : ℕ) (g : ℕ → R) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : m ≤ N) :
    (∑ x : Fin N, if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ m then g ((x : ℕ) + 1) else 0)
      = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun x => if x + 1 ∣ m then g (x + 1) else 0)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hset : (Finset.range N).filter (fun i => i + 1 ∣ m) = (Nat.divisors m).image (· - 1) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_image, Nat.mem_divisors]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hiN, hdvd⟩
      refine ⟨i + 1, ⟨hdvd, by omega⟩, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨d, ⟨hdvd, hmne⟩, hd⟩
      have hdle : d ≤ m := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
      have hdpos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd (by omega)
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      have heq1 : i = d - 1 := hd.symm
      rw [heq1]
      have heq2 : d - 1 + 1 = d := by omega
      rw [heq2]; exact hdvd
  rw [hset, Finset.sum_image]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d hd
    have hdvd := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hd).1
    have hdpos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd (by omega)
    have hde : d - 1 + 1 = d := by omega
    rw [hde]
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only at hab
    have hapos : 1 ≤ a := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.mem_divisors.mp ha).1 (by omega)
    have hbpos : 1 ≤ b := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hb).1 (by omega)
    omega

name: SmithLCM.entrada_factorizacion_R
statement:
theorem entrada_factorizacion_R (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → R)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) (i j : Fin N) :
    ((zetaR (R := R) N)ᵀ * (diagR N g * zetaR (R := R) N)) i j = smithR N f i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp_rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, diagR_mul_zetaR N g, zetaR]
  have key : (∑ x : Fin N, (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (i : ℕ) + 1 then (1 : R) else 0)
        * (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 then g ((x : ℕ) + 1) else 0))
      = ∑ x : Fin N,
          (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) then g ((x : ℕ) + 1) else 0) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro x _
    by_cases h1 : (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (i : ℕ) + 1 <;> by_cases h2 : (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (j : ℕ) + 1 <;>
      simp [h1, h2, Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
  rw [key]
  have hgcdpos : 1 ≤ Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) := Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
  have hgcdle : Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) ≤ N := by
    have := Nat.gcd_le_left (m := (i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) (by omega)
    have hi := i.isLt
    omega
  rw [fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum N _ g hgcdpos hgcdle]
  exact (hyp _ hgcdpos).symm

name: SmithLCM.smithR_eq_factorizacion
statement:
theorem smithR_eq_factorizacion (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → R)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    smithR N f = (zetaR (R := R) N)ᵀ * (diagR N g * zetaR (R := R) N)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact (entrada_factorizacion_R N f g hyp i j).symm

name: SmithLCM.det_diagR
statement:
theorem det_diagR (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → R) :
    (diagR N g).det = ∏ i : Fin N, g ((i : ℕ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [diagR, Matrix.det_diagonal]

name: SmithLCM.smithR_determinant
statement:
theorem smithR_determinant (N : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → R)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → f m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    (smithR N f).det = ∏ i : Fin N, g ((i : ℕ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smithR_eq_factorizacion N f g hyp, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul,
      Matrix.det_transpose, det_zetaR, det_diagR]
  ring

name: SmithLCM.lcmMat_eq
statement:
theorem lcmMat_eq (N : ℕ) :
    lcmMat N = diagId N * smithR N (fun m => (1 : ℚ) / m) * diagId N
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  
  
  simp only [diagId, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul, smithR, lcmMat]
  have hgpos : 0 < Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) :=
    Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
  have hgQ : ((Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hgpos.ne'
  
  have hmulQ : ((Nat.gcd ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ)
        * ((Nat.lcm ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1) : ℕ) : ℚ)
      = (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (((j : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.gcd_mul_lcm ((i : ℕ) + 1) ((j : ℕ) + 1)
  field_simp
  linear_combination hmulQ

name: SmithLCM.det_diagId
statement:
theorem det_diagId (N : ℕ) :
    (diagId N).det = ∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [diagId, Matrix.det_diagonal]

name: SmithLCM.det_lcmMat
statement:
theorem det_lcmMat (N : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hyp : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → (1 : ℚ) / m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, g d) :
    (lcmMat N).det
      = (∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))
        * (∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))
        * ∏ i : Fin N, g ((i : ℕ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lcmMat_eq N, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, det_diagId,
      smithR_determinant N (fun m => (1 : ℚ) / m) g hyp]
  ring

name: SmithLCM.gLcm_spec
statement:
theorem gLcm_spec (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (1 : ℚ) / m = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, gLcm d
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ n, 0 < n →
      ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (ArithmeticFunction.moebius x.1 : ℚ) * (1 / x.2) = gLcm n :=
    fun _ _ => rfl
  exact ((ArithmeticFunction.sum_eq_iff_sum_mul_moebius_eq (R := ℚ)
    (f := gLcm) (g := fun n => (1 : ℚ) / n)).mpr h m (by omega)).symm

name: SmithLCM.det_lcm
statement:
theorem det_lcm (N : ℕ) :
    (lcmMat N).det
      = (∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))
        * (∏ i : Fin N, (((i : ℕ) + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ))
        * ∏ i : Fin N, gLcm ((i : ℕ) + 1)
proof:
:=
  det_lcmMat N gLcm (fun m hm => gLcm_spec m hm)

name: Panoptic.pq_def
statement: lemma pq_def (s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) : pq s n fp fn = s / den n fp fn
proof: := rfl

name: Panoptic.den_nonneg
statement: lemma den_nonneg (n fp fn : ℕ) : 0 ≤ den n fp fn
proof:
:= by
  unfold den
  positivity

name: Panoptic.pq_dup_iff
statement:
theorem pq_dup_iff (s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn) :
    pq s n fp fn < pq (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn ↔ pq s n fp fn < v
proof:
:= by
  have hd1 : (0 : ℝ) < den n fp fn + 1 := by linarith
  have hden : den (n + 1) fp fn = den n fp fn + 1 := by
    unfold den; push_cast; ring
  rw [pq_def, pq_def, hden]
  rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ hd hd1, div_lt_iff₀ hd]
  constructor
  · intro h; nlinarith
  · intro h; nlinarith

name: Panoptic.pq_lt_pq_dup
statement:
theorem pq_lt_pq_dup (s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn)
    (hv : pq s n fp fn < v) : pq s n fp fn < pq (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn
proof:
:=
  (pq_dup_iff s v n fp fn hd).mpr hv

name: Panoptic.pq_fp_lt
statement:
theorem pq_fp_lt (s : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn) :
    pq s n (fp + 1) fn < pq s n fp fn
proof:
:= by
  have hden : den n (fp + 1) fn = den n fp fn + 1 / 2 := by
    unfold den; push_cast; ring
  have hd2 : (0 : ℝ) < den n fp fn + 1 / 2 := by linarith
  rw [pq_def, pq_def, hden, div_lt_div_iff₀ hd2 hd]
  nlinarith

name: Panoptic.duplicado_sube_pero_uno_a_uno_baja
statement:
theorem duplicado_sube_pero_uno_a_uno_baja
    (s v : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (hd : 0 < den n fp fn)
    (hv : pq s n fp fn < v) :
    pq s n fp fn < pq (s + v) (n + 1) fp fn ∧ pq s n (fp + 1) fn < pq s n fp fn
proof:
:=
  ⟨pq_lt_pq_dup s v n fp fn hd hv, pq_fp_lt s n fp fn hs hd⟩

name: Panoptic.iou_testigo
statement: lemma iou_testigo : iou ({1, 2} : Finset ℕ) ({1, 2, 3, 4} : Finset ℕ) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold iou
  norm_num [Finset.inter_comm]

name: Panoptic.empata_con_dos_en_un_medio
statement:
theorem empata_con_dos_en_un_medio :
    ∃ (P A B : Finset ℕ), Disjoint A B ∧ (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ iou P A ∧ (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ iou P B
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨{1, 2, 3, 4}, {1, 2}, {3, 4}, by decide, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [show iou ({1,2,3,4} : Finset ℕ) {1,2} = iou ({1,2} : Finset ℕ) {1,2,3,4} by
      unfold iou; rw [Finset.inter_comm, Finset.union_comm]]
    rw [iou_testigo]
  · rw [show iou ({1,2,3,4} : Finset ℕ) {3,4} = 1 / 2 by
      unfold iou; norm_num]

name: Panoptic.umbral_exacto
statement:
theorem umbral_exacto :
    (∀ (P A B : Finset ℕ), Disjoint A B → (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P A → (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P B → False)
    ∧ ¬ (∀ (P A B : Finset ℕ), Disjoint A B → (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ iou P A → (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ iou P B → False)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun P A B hAB hA hB => empareja_a_lo_sumo_una P A B hAB hA hB, ?_⟩
  intro h
  obtain ⟨P, A, B, hAB, hA, hB⟩ := empata_con_dos_en_un_medio
  exact h P A B hAB hA hB

name: NotCongruentOne.Sol.x_ne_zero
statement: theorem Sol.x_ne_zero {x y z : ℤ} (h : Sol x y z) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  have h1 : 0 < y ^ 4 := Even.pow_pos (by decide) h.1
  have h2 : 0 ≤ z ^ 2 := sq_nonneg z
  have := h.2.2
  nlinarith

name: NotCongruentOne.exists_minimal
statement: theorem exists_minimal {x y z : ℤ} (h : Sol x y z) : ∃ x0 y0 z0, Minimal x0 y0 z0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Set ℕ := { n | ∃ s : ℤ × ℤ × ℤ, Sol s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2 ∧ n = s.1.natAbs }
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨x.natAbs, ⟨x, y, z⟩, h, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s0, hs0, hs1⟩ := Nat.find_spec hS
  refine ⟨s0.1, s0.2.1, s0.2.2, hs0, fun x1 y1 z1 h1 => ?_⟩
  rw [← hs1]
  exact Nat.find_min' hS ⟨⟨x1, y1, z1⟩, h1, rfl⟩

name: NotCongruentOne.coprime_xy
statement: theorem coprime_xy {x y z : ℤ} (h : Minimal x y z) : Int.gcd x y = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hxy
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx, hpy⟩ := Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mp hxy
  obtain ⟨x1, rfl⟩ := Int.natCast_dvd.mpr hpx
  obtain ⟨y1, rfl⟩ := Int.natCast_dvd.mpr hpy
  have hpz : (p : ℤ) ^ 2 ∣ z := by
    rw [← Int.pow_dvd_pow_iff two_ne_zero, ← h.1.2.2]
    exact ⟨x1 ^ 4 - y1 ^ 4, by ring⟩
  obtain ⟨z1, rfl⟩ := hpz
  have hp0 : (p : ℤ) ≠ 0 := Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hp.ne_zero
  have hs : Sol x1 y1 z1 := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro rfl; exact h.1.1 (by simp)
    · rintro rfl; exact h.1.2.1 (by simp)
    · have := h.1.2.2
      have hp4 : ((p : ℤ) ^ 4) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 4 hp0
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hp4
      linear_combination this
  have hx1 : x1 ≠ 0 := hs.x_ne_zero
  apply Nat.le_lt_asymm (h.2 _ _ _ hs)
  rw [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast]
  have := hp.one_lt
  have : 0 < x1.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hx1
  nlinarith

name: NotCongruentOne.coprime_yz
statement: theorem coprime_yz {x y z : ℤ} (h : Minimal x y z) : Int.gcd y z = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hyz
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpy, hpz⟩ := Nat.Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd.mp hyz
  have hpy' : (p : ℤ) ∣ y := Int.natCast_dvd.mpr hpy
  have hpz' : (p : ℤ) ∣ z := Int.natCast_dvd.mpr hpz
  have hpx4 : (p : ℤ) ∣ x ^ 4 := by
    have : x ^ 4 = y ^ 4 + z ^ 2 := by linear_combination h.1.2.2
    rw [this]
    exact dvd_add (dvd_pow hpy' (by norm_num)) (dvd_pow hpz' (by norm_num))
  have hpx : (p : ℤ) ∣ x := Int.Prime.dvd_pow' hp hpx4
  have h1 : (p : ℤ) ∣ (Int.gcd x y : ℤ) := Int.dvd_coe_gcd hpx hpy'
  rw [coprime_xy h] at h1
  have := Int.eq_one_of_dvd_one (by positivity) h1
  exact hp.one_lt.ne' (by exact_mod_cast this)

name: NotCongruentOne.descenso_par
statement:
theorem descenso_par {o e x y : ℤ} (ho : 0 < o) (he : 0 < e) (hx : 0 < x) (ho2 : o % 2 = 1)
    (he2 : e % 2 = 0) (hoe : Int.gcd o e = 1) (hxoe : x ^ 2 = o ^ 2 + e ^ 2)
    (hy : y ^ 2 = 2 * o * e) :
    ∃ u v q, Sol u v q ∧ u.natAbs < x.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e', rfl⟩ : 2 ∣ e := Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero he2
  have he' : 0 < e' := by linarith
  have hy2 : (2 : ℤ) ∣ y := by
    have h2 : ((2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ y := Int.Prime.dvd_pow' (k := 2) Nat.prime_two
      (by rw [hy]; exact ⟨o * (2 * e'), by push_cast; ring⟩)
    exact_mod_cast h2
  obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hy2
  have hy' : o * e' = y' ^ 2 :=
    mul_left_cancel₀ (by norm_num : (4 : ℤ) ≠ 0) (by linear_combination -hy)
  have hoe' : Int.gcd o e' = 1 := by
    apply Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mp
    exact (Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr hoe).of_mul_right_right
  
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Int.sq_of_gcd_eq_one hoe' hy'
  have hq' : o = q ^ 2 := hq.resolve_right (by intro h; nlinarith [sq_nonneg q])
  
  have ht : PythagoreanTriple o (2 * e') x := by
    delta PythagoreanTriple
    linear_combination -hxoe
  obtain ⟨r, s, h1, h2, h3, h4, -, h6⟩ := ht.coprime_classification' hoe ho2 hx
  have hrs : e' = r * s := mul_left_cancel₀ (two_ne_zero) (by linear_combination h2)
  have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hrs; linarith
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_ne h6 (Ne.symm hr0)
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    rcases le_or_gt s 0 with hs | hs
    · have : r * s ≤ 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hr.le hs
      linarith
    · exact hs
  
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p, e' = p ^ 2 := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Int.sq_of_gcd_eq_one (by rw [Int.gcd_comm]; exact hoe')
      (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hy')
    exact ⟨p, hp.resolve_right (by intro h; nlinarith [sq_nonneg p])⟩
  have hrsp : r * s = p ^ 2 := by rw [← hrs, hp]
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Int.sq_of_gcd_eq_one h4 hrsp
  have hu' : r = u ^ 2 := hu.resolve_right (by intro h; nlinarith [sq_nonneg u])
  have h4' : Int.gcd s r = 1 := by rw [Int.gcd_comm]; exact h4
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Int.sq_of_gcd_eq_one h4' (by rw [mul_comm]; exact hrsp)
  have hv' : s = v ^ 2 := hv.resolve_right (by intro h; nlinarith [sq_nonneg v])
  refine ⟨u, v, q, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro rfl; simp at hv'; linarith
  · rintro rfl; simp at hq'; linarith
  · rw [← hq', h1, hu', hv']; ring
  · rw [Int.natAbs_lt_iff_sq_lt]
    have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := by omega
    have hx1 : 1 ≤ x := by omega
    have hs2 : 0 < s ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hrr : r ≤ r ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq]; simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr1 hr.le
    have hxx : x ≤ x ^ 2 := by
      rw [sq]; simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx1 hx.le
    calc u ^ 2 = r := hu'.symm
      _ ≤ r ^ 2 := hrr
      _ < r ^ 2 + s ^ 2 := by linarith
      _ = x := h3.symm
      _ ≤ x ^ 2 := hxx

name: NotCongruentOne.not_minimal
statement: theorem not_minimal {x y z : ℤ} (h : Minimal x y z) : False
proof:
:= by
  
  set X : ℤ := (x.natAbs : ℤ) with hX
  set Y : ℤ := (y.natAbs : ℤ) with hY
  set Z : ℤ := (z.natAbs : ℤ) with hZ
  have hX2 : X ^ 2 = x ^ 2 := Int.natAbs_sq x
  have hY2 : Y ^ 2 = y ^ 2 := Int.natAbs_sq y
  have hZ2 : Z ^ 2 = z ^ 2 := Int.natAbs_sq z
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := h.1.x_ne_zero
  have hXp : 0 < X := Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hx0)
  have hYp : 0 < Y := Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr h.1.1)
  have hZp : 0 < Z := Int.natCast_pos.mpr (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr h.1.2.1)
  have heq : X ^ 4 - Y ^ 4 = Z ^ 2 := by
    have := h.1.2.2
    calc X ^ 4 - Y ^ 4 = (X ^ 2) ^ 2 - (Y ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = (x ^ 2) ^ 2 - (y ^ 2) ^ 2 := by rw [hX2, hY2]
      _ = z ^ 2 := by linear_combination this
      _ = Z ^ 2 := hZ2.symm
  have hcxy : Int.gcd X Y = 1 := by
    have := coprime_xy h
    simpa [X, Y, Int.gcd, Int.natAbs_abs] using this
  have hcyz : Int.gcd Y Z = 1 := by
    have := coprime_yz h
    simpa [Y, Z, Int.gcd, Int.natAbs_abs] using this
  have hXabs : X.natAbs = x.natAbs := by simp [X, Int.natAbs_abs]
  
  have menor : ∀ u v q, Sol u v q → u.natAbs < X.natAbs → False := by
    intro u v q hs hlt
    have := h.2 u v q hs
    omega
  rcases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one Y with hYe | hYo
  · 
    have hZo : Z % 2 = 1 := by
      rcases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one Z with hZe | hZo
      · exfalso
        have h2 : (2 : ℤ) ∣ (Int.gcd Y Z : ℤ) :=
          Int.dvd_coe_gcd (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero hYe) (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero hZe)
        rw [hcyz] at h2
        revert h2; decide
      · exact hZo
    have ht : PythagoreanTriple Z (Y ^ 2) (X ^ 2) := by
      delta PythagoreanTriple
      linear_combination -heq
    have hg : Int.gcd Z (Y ^ 2) = 1 := by
      rw [Int.gcd_comm]
      exact Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mp (Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr hcyz).pow_left
    obtain ⟨m, n, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6⟩ := ht.coprime_classification' hg hZo (by positivity)
    have hm : 0 < m := by
      rcases h6.lt_or_eq with h6 | h6
      · exact h6
      · subst h6; have : 0 < Y ^ 2 := by positivity
        simp at h2; linarith
    have hn : 0 < n := by
      have : 0 < Y ^ 2 := by positivity
      rcases le_or_gt n 0 with hn | hn
      · have : 2 * m * n ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
        linarith
      · exact hn
    rcases h5 with ⟨hme, hno⟩ | ⟨hmo, hne⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, v, q, hs, hlt⟩ := descenso_par hn hm hXp hno hme
        (by rw [Int.gcd_comm]; exact h4) (show X ^ 2 = n ^ 2 + m ^ 2 by rw [h3]; ring)
        (show Y ^ 2 = 2 * n * m by rw [h2]; ring)
      exact menor u v q hs hlt
    · obtain ⟨u, v, q, hs, hlt⟩ := descenso_par hm hn hXp hmo hne h4 h3 h2
      exact menor u v q hs hlt
  · 
    have ht : PythagoreanTriple (Y ^ 2) Z (X ^ 2) := by
      delta PythagoreanTriple
      linear_combination -heq
    have hg : Int.gcd (Y ^ 2) Z = 1 :=
      Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mp (Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one.mpr hcyz).pow_left
    have hY22 : Y ^ 2 % 2 = 1 := by rw [sq, Int.mul_emod, hYo]; decide
    obtain ⟨m, n, h1, h2, h3, h4, -, -⟩ := ht.coprime_classification' hg hY22 (by positivity)
    have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at h2; linarith
    refine menor m n (X * Y) ⟨hn0, by positivity, ?_⟩ ?_
    · have : X ^ 2 * Y ^ 2 = (m ^ 2 + n ^ 2) * (m ^ 2 - n ^ 2) := by rw [h3, h1]
      linear_combination -this
    · rw [Int.natAbs_lt_iff_sq_lt, h3]
      have : 0 < n ^ 2 := by positivity
      linarith

name: NotCongruentOne.not_fermat_4_minus
statement: theorem not_fermat_4_minus {x y z : ℤ} (hy : y ≠ 0) (hz : z ≠ 0) : x ^ 4 - y ^ 4 ≠ z ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x0, y0, z0, hm⟩ := exists_minimal ⟨hy, hz, h⟩
  exact not_minimal hm

name: NotCongruentOne.not_congruentNumber_1
statement: theorem not_congruentNumber_1 : ¬ congruentNumber 1
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, b, c, hp, ha⟩
  have hab : a * b = 2 := by push_cast at ha; linarith
  by_cases hsq : a ^ 2 = b ^ 2
  · 
    have ha2 : a ^ 2 = 2 := by
      have h0 : (a ^ 2 - 2) * (a ^ 2 + 2) = 0 := by
        linear_combination a ^ 2 * hsq + (a * b + 2) * hab
      have hpos : a ^ 2 + 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp h0).resolve_right hpos
      linarith
    apply irrational_sqrt_two
    refine ⟨|a|, ?_⟩
    rw [Rat.cast_abs, ← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    congr 1
    exact_mod_cast ha2
  · 
    set D : ℤ := (a.den : ℤ) * b.den * c.den with hD
    have hD0 : (D : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      simp only [hD]; push_cast; positivity
    set A : ℤ := a.num * b.den * c.den
    set B : ℤ := b.num * a.den * c.den
    set C : ℤ := c.num * a.den * b.den
    have hA : (A : ℚ) = a * D := by
      simp only [A, hD]; push_cast; rw [← Rat.mul_den_eq_num a]; ring
    have hB : (B : ℚ) = b * D := by
      simp only [B, hD]; push_cast; rw [← Rat.mul_den_eq_num b]; ring
    have hC : (C : ℚ) = c * D := by
      simp only [C, hD]; push_cast; rw [← Rat.mul_den_eq_num c]; ring
    have hpZ : A ^ 2 + B ^ 2 = C ^ 2 := by
      have : (A : ℚ) ^ 2 + (B : ℚ) ^ 2 = (C : ℚ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hA, hB, hC]; linear_combination (D : ℚ) ^ 2 * hp
      exact_mod_cast this
    have habZ : A * B = 2 * D ^ 2 := by
      have : (A : ℚ) * B = 2 * (D : ℚ) ^ 2 := by
        rw [hA, hB]; linear_combination (D : ℚ) ^ 2 * hab
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hne : A ^ 2 - B ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hsq
      have : (A : ℚ) ^ 2 = (B : ℚ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast (sub_eq_zero.mp h0)
      rw [hA, hB] at this
      have hD2 : (D : ℚ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hD0
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ hD2
      linear_combination this
    have hD0' : D ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hD0
    apply not_fermat_4_minus (x := C) (y := 2 * D) (z := A ^ 2 - B ^ 2)
      (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hD0') hne
    linear_combination (C ^ 2 + A ^ 2 + B ^ 2) * hpZ.symm + 4 * (A * B + 2 * D ^ 2) * habZ

private theorem S_formula (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + 1), (n + 2).choose (j + 1) = 2 ^ (n + 2) - (n + 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 3), (n + 2).choose i = 2 ^ (n + 2) :=
    Nat.sum_range_choose (n + 2)
  have hreindex : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + 1), (n + 2).choose (j + 1)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (n + 2), (n + 2).choose i := by
    apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun j => j + 1) (fun i => i - 1) <;> intros <;> simp_all <;> omega
  rw [hreindex]
  have hsplit : Finset.range (n + 3) = insert 0 (insert 1 (Finset.Icc 2 (n + 2))) := by
    ext x; simp [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Icc]; omega
  rw [hsplit] at hsum
  rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp), Finset.sum_insert (by simp)] at hsum
  simp [Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.choose_one_right] at hsum
  omega

  have hn3 : Even (n + 3) := by obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := himpar; exact ⟨k + 2, by omega⟩

name: BSDParidad.even_card_of_fixedPointFree_involution
statement:
theorem even_card_of_fixedPointFree_involution {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] :
    ∀ S : Finset α, ∀ f : α → α, (∀ x ∈ S, f x ∈ S) → (∀ x ∈ S, f (f x) = x) →
      (∀ x ∈ S, f x ≠ x) → Even S.card
proof:
:= by
  intro S
  induction S using Finset.strongInduction with
  | _ S ih =>
    intro f hmaps hinv hfree
    rcases S.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hemp | ⟨x, hx⟩
    · simp [hemp]
    · set y := f x with hydef
      have hy : y ∈ S := hmaps x hx
      have hxy : x ≠ y := (hfree x hx).symm
      set S' := (S.erase x).erase y with hS'def
      have hxS' : x ∉ S' := by simp [hS'def]
      have hyS' : y ∉ S' := by simp [hS'def]
      have hss : S' ⊂ S := by
        apply Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset (by
          intro a ha
          simp only [hS'def, Finset.mem_erase] at ha
          exact ha.2.2) |>.mpr
        exact ⟨x, hx, hxS'⟩
      have hcard : S.card = S'.card + 2 := by
        have h1 : (S.erase x).card = S.card - 1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hx
        have hyS_erase : y ∈ S.erase x := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨Ne.symm hxy, hy⟩
        have h2 : S'.card = (S.erase x).card - 1 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem hyS_erase
        have hSpos : 1 ≤ S.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨x, hx⟩
        have hSpos2 : 1 ≤ (S.erase x).card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨y, hyS_erase⟩
        omega
      have hfinj : ∀ a ∈ S, ∀ b ∈ S, f a = f b → a = b := by
        intro a ha b hb hab
        have := hinv a ha
        rw [hab, hinv b hb] at this
        exact this.symm
      have hmaps' : ∀ z ∈ S', f z ∈ S' := by
        intro z hz
        have hzS : z ∈ S := by
          simp only [hS'def, Finset.mem_erase] at hz
          exact hz.2.2
        have hzx : z ≠ x := by
          simp only [hS'def, Finset.mem_erase] at hz
          exact hz.2.1
        have hzy : z ≠ y := by
          simp only [hS'def, Finset.mem_erase] at hz
          exact hz.1
        have hfz : f z ∈ S := hmaps z hzS
        have hfzx : f z ≠ x := by
          intro hcon
          apply hzy
          have hfyx : f y = x := by rw [hydef]; exact hinv x hx
          have heq : f z = f y := hcon.trans hfyx.symm
          exact hfinj z hzS y hy heq
        have hfzy : f z ≠ y := by
          intro hcon
          apply hzx
          have heq : f z = f x := hcon.trans hydef
          exact hfinj z hzS x hx heq
        simp only [hS'def, Finset.mem_erase]
        exact ⟨hfzy, hfzx, hfz⟩
      have hinv' : ∀ z ∈ S', f (f z) = z := by
        intro z hz
        have hzS : z ∈ S := by
          simp only [hS'def, Finset.mem_erase] at hz; exact hz.2.2
        exact hinv z hzS
      have hfree' : ∀ z ∈ S', f z ≠ z := by
        intro z hz
        have hzS : z ∈ S := by
          simp only [hS'def, Finset.mem_erase] at hz; exact hz.2.2
        exact hfree z hzS
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih S' hss f hmaps' hinv' hfree'
      exact ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩

name: BSDParidad.tunnell_par
statement:
theorem tunnell_par (a c n : ℤ) (ha : Even a) (hc : Even c) (hn : Odd n) (_hn0 : 0 ≤ n)
    (_ha_pos : 0 < a) (_hc_pos : 0 < c) :
    Even (solTunnell a c n).card
proof:
:= by
  apply even_card_of_fixedPointFree_involution (solTunnell a c n) (fun p => (p.1, -p.2.1, p.2.2))
  · intro p hp
    simp only [solTunnell, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at hp ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨hy1, hy2⟩, ⟨hz1, hz2⟩⟩, heq⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨⟨⟨hx1, hx2⟩, ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, ⟨hz1, hz2⟩⟩, by rw [neg_sq]; exact heq⟩
  · intro p hp
    simp
  · intro p hp hcon
    simp only [solTunnell, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Icc] at hp
    obtain ⟨_, heq⟩ := hp
    have hy0 : p.2.1 = 0 := by
      have heqp : (p.1, -p.2.1, p.2.2) = p := hcon
      have : -p.2.1 = p.2.1 := congrArg (fun q => q.2.1) heqp
      omega
    rw [hy0] at heq
    have heven : Even (a * p.1 ^ 2 + (0 : ℤ) ^ 2 + c * p.2.2 ^ 2) := by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ha
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hc
      exact ⟨k * p.1 ^ 2 + 0 + j * p.2.2 ^ 2, by rw [hk, hj]; ring⟩
    rw [heq] at heven
    exact (Int.not_odd_iff_even.mpr heven) hn

    have hi : (i : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun hh => h (Fin.ext (by simpa using hh))
    omega

name: Redheffer.redheffer_eq
statement:
theorem redheffer_eq (N : ℕ) :
    redheffer (N + 1) = (zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 (fun _ => 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.updateCol_apply]
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · subst hj; rw [if_pos rfl]; simp only [redheffer, Fin.val_zero, true_or, if_true]
  · rw [if_neg hj]
    have hj0 : (j : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun hh => hj (Fin.ext (by simpa using hh))
    simp only [redheffer, zeta, hj0, false_or]

name: Redheffer.redheffer_reduccion
statement:
theorem redheffer_reduccion (N : ℕ) :
    (redheffer (N + 1)).det
      = 1 + ((zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then 0 else 1)).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [redheffer_eq]
  have hsplit : (fun _ : Fin (N + 1) => (1 : ℤ))
      = (fun i => if i = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) + (fun i => if i = 0 then (0 : ℤ) else 1) := by
    funext i; by_cases h : i = 0 <;> simp [h]
  rw [hsplit, Matrix.det_updateCol_add]
  congr 1
  have hcol : (zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) = zeta (N + 1) := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.updateCol_apply]
    by_cases hj : j = 0
    · subst hj; rw [if_pos rfl, zeta_col0]
    · rw [if_neg hj]
  rw [hcol, det_zeta]

name: Redheffer.redheffer_de_crux
statement:
theorem redheffer_de_crux (N : ℕ)
    (crux : ((zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then 0 else 1)).det
              = mertens (N + 1) - 1) :
    (redheffer (N + 1)).det = mertens (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [redheffer_reduccion, crux]; ring

name: Redheffer.suma_mu_divisores
statement:
theorem suma_mu_divisores (k : ℕ) :
    (∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors k, (μ d : ℤ)) = if k = 1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((μ * ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℤ)) k
      = ∑ i ∈ Nat.divisors k, (μ i : ℤ) := ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul_zeta_apply
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.moebius_mul_coe_zeta] at h
  rw [← h]; simp [ArithmeticFunction.one_apply]

name: Redheffer.fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum
statement:
theorem fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum (N : ℕ) (m : ℕ) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : m ≤ N) :
    (∑ x : Fin N, if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ m then (μ ((x : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0)
      = ∑ d ∈ Nat.divisors m, (μ d : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun x => if x + 1 ∣ m then (μ (x + 1) : ℤ) else 0)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hset : (Finset.range N).filter (fun i => i + 1 ∣ m) = (Nat.divisors m).image (· - 1) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_image, Nat.mem_divisors]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hiN, hdvd⟩
      refine ⟨i + 1, ⟨hdvd, by omega⟩, by omega⟩
    · rintro ⟨d, ⟨hdvd, hmne⟩, hd⟩
      have hdle : d ≤ m := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
      have hdpos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd (by omega)
      constructor
      · omega
      · have heq1 : i = d - 1 := hd.symm
        rw [heq1]
        have heq2 : d - 1 + 1 = d := by omega
        rw [heq2]; exact hdvd
  rw [hset, Finset.sum_image]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro d hd
    have hdvd := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hd).1
    have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
    have hdpos : 1 ≤ d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd hmpos
    congr 1
    omega
  · intro a ha b hb hab
    simp only at hab
    have hapos : 1 ≤ a := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.mem_divisors.mp ha).1 (by omega)
    have hbpos : 1 ≤ b := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hb).1 (by omega)
    omega

name: Redheffer.vecMul_mu_zeta
statement:
theorem vecMul_mu_zeta (N : ℕ) :
    Matrix.vecMul (murow N) (zeta (N + 1)) = fun k => if k = 0 then (1 : ℤ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp only [Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, murow, zeta]
  rw [show (∑ x : Fin (N + 1), (μ ((x : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ)
        * (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (k : ℕ) + 1 then (1 : ℤ) else 0))
      = ∑ x : Fin (N + 1), (if (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (k : ℕ) + 1 then (μ ((x : ℕ) + 1) : ℤ) else 0)
      from by apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro x _
              by_cases h : (x : ℕ) + 1 ∣ (k : ℕ) + 1 <;> simp [h]]
  rw [fin_sum_eq_divisors_sum (N + 1) ((k : ℕ) + 1) (by omega) (by omega)]
  rw [suma_mu_divisores]
  by_cases hk : k = 0 <;> simp [hk]

name: Redheffer.fila_inversa
statement:
theorem fila_inversa (N : ℕ) :
    murow N = Matrix.vecMul (fun k => if k = (0 : Fin (N + 1)) then (1 : ℤ) else 0)
      (zeta (N + 1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (zeta (N + 1)).det := det_zeta (N + 1) ▸ isUnit_one
  have step : Matrix.vecMul (Matrix.vecMul (murow N) (zeta (N + 1))) (zeta (N + 1))⁻¹
      = Matrix.vecMul (fun k => if k = (0 : Fin (N + 1)) then (1 : ℤ) else 0) (zeta (N + 1))⁻¹ := by
    rw [vecMul_mu_zeta]
  rw [Matrix.vecMul_vecMul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hunit, Matrix.vecMul_one] at step
  exact step

name: Redheffer.crux_general
statement:
theorem crux_general (N : ℕ) (u : Fin (N + 1) → ℤ) :
    ((zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 u).det = ∑ j, murow N j * u j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.cramer_apply]
  have hunit : IsUnit (zeta (N + 1)).det := det_zeta (N + 1) ▸ isUnit_one
  have hc := Matrix.det_smul_inv_mulVec_eq_cramer (zeta (N + 1)) u hunit
  rw [det_zeta, one_smul] at hc
  rw [← hc, fila_inversa N]
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.vecMul]

name: Redheffer.range_a_Icc2
statement:
theorem range_a_Icc2 (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, (μ (i + 2) : ℤ)) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (N + 1), (μ k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nbij' (fun i => i + 2) (fun k => k - 2) <;> intros <;> simp_all
  all_goals omega

name: Redheffer.mertens_peel
statement: theorem mertens_peel (N : ℕ) : mertens (N + 1) = 1 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 2 (N + 1), (μ k : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mertens
  rw [show Finset.Icc 1 (N + 1) = insert 1 (Finset.Icc 2 (N + 1)) by
    ext x; simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_insert]; omega]
  rw [Finset.sum_insert (by simp)]
  norm_num [ArithmeticFunction.moebius_apply_one]

name: Redheffer.suma_a_mertens
statement:
theorem suma_a_mertens (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ j : Fin (N + 1), (if j = 0 then (0 : ℤ) else murow N j)) = mertens (N + 1) - 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold murow
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  have h0 : (if (0 : Fin (N + 1)) = 0 then (0 : ℤ) else μ (((0 : Fin (N + 1)) : ℕ) + 1)) = 0 := by
    simp
  have hstep : ∀ i : Fin N,
      (if (Fin.succ i : Fin (N + 1)) = 0 then (0 : ℤ)
       else μ (((Fin.succ i : Fin (N + 1)) : ℕ) + 1)) = μ ((i : ℕ) + 2) := by
    intro i
    rw [if_neg (Fin.succ_ne_zero i), Fin.val_succ]
  rw [h0]
  simp_rw [hstep]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => (μ (i + 2) : ℤ))]
  rw [range_a_Icc2, mertens_peel]
  ring

name: Redheffer.redheffer_general
statement: theorem redheffer_general (N : ℕ) : (redheffer (N + 1)).det = mertens (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply redheffer_de_crux
  rw [crux_general]
  have heq := suma_a_mertens N
  rw [← heq]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  by_cases h : j = 0 <;> simp [h, murow]

name: Redheffer.mertens_1
statement: theorem mertens_1 : mertens 1 = 1
proof: := by unfold mertens; simp

name: Redheffer.mertens_2
statement: theorem mertens_2 : mertens 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold mertens
  rw [show Finset.Icc 1 2 = {1, 2} by decide]
  simp [ArithmeticFunction.moebius_apply_prime Nat.prime_two]

name: Redheffer.mertens_3
statement: theorem mertens_3 : mertens 3 = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold mertens
  rw [show Finset.Icc 1 3 = {1, 2, 3} by decide]
  simp [ArithmeticFunction.moebius_apply_prime Nat.prime_two,
        ArithmeticFunction.moebius_apply_prime Nat.prime_three]

name: Redheffer.redheffer_1
statement: theorem redheffer_1 : (redheffer 1).det = mertens 1
proof: := redheffer_general 0

name: Redheffer.redheffer_2
statement: theorem redheffer_2 : (redheffer 2).det = mertens 2
proof: := redheffer_general 1

name: Redheffer.redheffer_3
statement: theorem redheffer_3 : (redheffer 3).det = mertens 3
proof: := redheffer_general 2

name: Redheffer.redheffer_pesada
statement:
theorem redheffer_pesada (N : ℕ) :
    ((zeta (N + 1)).updateCol 0 (fun i => (i : ℤ) + 1)).det = mertens_pesada (N + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [crux_general]
  unfold murow mertens_pesada
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => (μ (j + 1) : ℤ) * ((j : ℤ) + 1))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _; ring

name: BSDTwist.a_p_twist
statement:
theorem a_p_twist (n : ℤ) (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hn : (n : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    a_p n p = quadraticChar (ZMod p) (n : ZMod p) * a_p 1 p
proof:
:= by
  have hcube : quadraticChar (ZMod p) ((n : ZMod p) ^ 3) = quadraticChar (ZMod p) (n : ZMod p) := by
    have h3 : (n : ZMod p) ^ 3 = (n : ZMod p) * (n : ZMod p) * (n : ZMod p) := by ring
    rw [h3, map_mul, map_mul]
    rcases quadraticChar_dichotomy hn with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> ring
  unfold a_p
  have hbij : ∑ x : ZMod p, quadraticChar (ZMod p) (x ^ 3 - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 * x)
      = ∑ t : ZMod p, quadraticChar (ZMod p)
          (((n : ZMod p) * t) ^ 3 - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 * ((n : ZMod p) * t)) :=
    (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.mulLeft₀ (n : ZMod p) hn)
      (fun x => quadraticChar (ZMod p) (x ^ 3 - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 * x))).symm
  rw [hbij]
  have hstep : ∀ t : ZMod p,
      quadraticChar (ZMod p) (((n : ZMod p) * t) ^ 3 - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 * ((n : ZMod p) * t))
        = quadraticChar (ZMod p) (n : ZMod p) * quadraticChar (ZMod p) (t ^ 3 - t) := by
    intro t
    have heq : ((n : ZMod p) * t) ^ 3 - (n : ZMod p) ^ 2 * ((n : ZMod p) * t)
        = (n : ZMod p) ^ 3 * (t ^ 3 - t) := by ring
    rw [heq, map_mul, hcube]
  simp_rw [hstep]
  
  
  simp only [Int.cast_one, one_pow, one_mul, Finset.mul_sum, mul_neg]

name: Panoptic.card_inter_gt_of_iou
statement:
lemma card_inter_gt_of_iou (P A : Finset α) (h : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P A) :
    (P.card : ℝ) < 2 * ((P ∩ A).card : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold iou at h
  have hu : (0 : ℝ) < ((P ∪ A).card : ℝ) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (P ∪ A).card with h0 | hpos
    · rw [h0] at h; norm_num at h
    · exact_mod_cast hpos
  have hle : (P.card : ℝ) ≤ ((P ∪ A).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast card_le_card subset_union_left
  rw [div_lt_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2) hu] at h
  linarith

name: Panoptic.empareja_a_lo_sumo_una
statement:
theorem empareja_a_lo_sumo_una (P A B : Finset α) (hAB : Disjoint A B)
    (hA : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P A) (hB : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < iou P B) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hpa := card_inter_gt_of_iou P A hA
  have hpb := card_inter_gt_of_iou P B hB
  have hdis : Disjoint (P ∩ A) (P ∩ B) :=
    (hAB.mono inter_subset_right inter_subset_right)
  have hsub : (P ∩ A) ∪ (P ∩ B) ⊆ P := union_subset inter_subset_left inter_subset_left
  have hcard : ((P ∩ A).card : ℝ) + ((P ∩ B).card : ℝ) ≤ (P.card : ℝ) := by
    have : (P ∩ A).card + (P ∩ B).card = ((P ∩ A) ∪ (P ∩ B)).card :=
      (card_union_of_disjoint hdis).symm
    have h2 : ((P ∩ A) ∪ (P ∩ B)).card ≤ P.card := card_le_card hsub
    exact_mod_cast this ▸ h2
  linarith

name: Panoptic.den_una_anotacion
statement:
lemma den_una_anotacion (tp m a : ℕ) (h1 : tp ≤ m) (h2 : tp ≤ a) :
    den tp (m - tp) (a - tp) = ((m : ℝ) + a) / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold den
  rw [Nat.cast_sub h1, Nat.cast_sub h2]
  ring

name: Panoptic.techo_dos_anotadores
statement:
theorem techo_dos_anotadores (m a b tpA tpB : ℕ)
    (hab : a < b) (hA : tpA ≤ a) (hB : tpB ≤ m) :
    ((tpA : ℝ) + tpB) < (m : ℝ) + ((a : ℝ) + b) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (tpA : ℝ) ≤ (a : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hA
  have h2 : (tpB : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have h3 : (a : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hab
  linarith

name: Panoptic.pq_lt_one_de_desacuerdo
statement:
theorem pq_lt_one_de_desacuerdo (sA sB : ℝ) (m a b tpA tpB : ℕ)
    (hab : a < b) (hA : tpA ≤ a) (hB : tpB ≤ m)
    (hsA : sA ≤ tpA) (hsB : sB ≤ tpB) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (sA + sB) / ((m : ℝ) + ((a : ℝ) + b) / 2) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) + ((a : ℝ) + b) / 2 := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
    positivity
  rw [div_lt_one hden]
  have := techo_dos_anotadores m a b tpA tpB hab hA hB
  linarith

name: Panoptic.den_quitar_acierto
statement:
lemma den_quitar_acierto (n fp m : ℕ) :
    den n fp (m + 1) = den (n + 1) fp m - 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold den; push_cast; ring

name: Panoptic.den_quitar_fallo
statement:
lemma den_quitar_fallo (n fp m : ℕ) :
    den n fp m = den n (fp + 1) m - 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold den; push_cast; ring

name: Panoptic.pq_quitar_iff
statement:
theorem pq_quitar_iff (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 1 / 2 < den n fp fn) :
    pq s n fp fn < pqQuitar s p j n fp fn ↔ p * j < pq s n fp fn / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) < den n fp fn := by linarith
  have hd2 : (0 : ℝ) < den n fp fn - 1 / 2 := by linarith
  unfold pqQuitar
  rw [pq_def, div_lt_div_iff₀ hd0 hd2, div_div,
      lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < den n fp fn * 2)]
  constructor
  · intro h; nlinarith
  · intro h; nlinarith

name: Panoptic.pq_lt_quitar
statement:
theorem pq_lt_quitar (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 1 / 2 < den n fp fn)
    (h : p * j < pq s n fp fn / 2) : pq s n fp fn < pqQuitar s p j n fp fn
proof:
:=
  (pq_quitar_iff s p j n fp fn hd).mpr h

name: Panoptic.quitar_le_pq
statement:
theorem quitar_le_pq (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) (hd : 1 / 2 < den n fp fn)
    (h : pq s n fp fn / 2 ≤ p * j) : pqQuitar s p j n fp fn ≤ pq s n fp fn
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_lt]
  intro hc
  exact absurd ((pq_quitar_iff s p j n fp fn hd).mp hc) (not_lt.mpr h)

name: Panoptic.quitar_candidato
statement:
theorem quitar_candidato (s p j : ℝ) (n fp fn : ℕ) :
    (s + p * j - p * j) / (den n fp fn + 1 / 2 - 1 / 2) = pq s n fp fn
proof:
:= by
  rw [pq_def]; ring_nf

name: SmithLCMForma.dvd_radical_of_squarefree
statement:
theorem dvd_radical_of_squarefree {d n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hd : d ∣ n) (hsq : Squarefree d) :
    d ∣ radical n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.radical_eq_prod_primeFactors]
  have : d = ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, p := (Nat.prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hsq).symm
  rw [this]
  exact Finset.prod_dvd_prod_of_subset _ _ _ (Nat.primeFactors_mono hd hn)

name: SmithLCMForma.sum_moebius_mul_eq_prod_one_sub
statement:
theorem sum_moebius_mul_eq_prod_one_sub (f : ArithmeticFunction R)
    (hf : f.IsMultiplicative) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (μ d : R) * f d = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 - f p)
proof:
:= by
  have hrad : radical n ≠ 0 := (Nat.radical_pos n).ne'
  
  have paso : ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (μ d : R) * f d
      = ∑ d ∈ (radical n).divisors, (μ d : R) * f d := by
    refine (Finset.sum_subset ?_ ?_).symm
    · exact Nat.divisors_subset_of_dvd hn radical_dvd_self
    · intro d hd hno
      have hdn : d ∣ n := (Nat.mem_divisors.mp hd).1
      have : ¬ Squarefree d := by
        intro hsq
        exact hno (Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨dvd_radical_of_squarefree hn hdn hsq, hrad⟩)
      rw [ArithmeticFunction.moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree this]
      simp
  
  rw [paso, ← hf.prodPrimeFactors_one_sub_of_squarefree f squarefree_radical,
      Nat.primeFactors_radical]

name: SmithLCMForma.sum_moebius_mul_id
statement:
theorem sum_moebius_mul_id {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (μ d : ℚ) * (d : ℚ)
      = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  
  have := sum_moebius_mul_eq_prod_one_sub
    (R := ℚ) ((ArithmeticFunction.id : ArithmeticFunction ℕ) : ArithmeticFunction ℚ)
    ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_id.natCast hn
  simpa using this
